title: Ideal Airspeed Correction
text: 根据彼此计算等效空速 (EAS)、校准空速 (CAS) 或真实空速 (TAS)，输入 5 路、输出 3 路；按 {Units} 指定单位 Metric；{Airspeed input}、{Airspeed output}、{Method}、{Subsonic airspeeds only} 用于亚声速空速、{Action for out-of-range input} 指定超出范围时的模块行为，按实例取值。

params.name: Units
params.values: 单位 Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Airspeed input
params.values: Airspeed input type TAS (default) | EAS | CAS

params.name: Airspeed output
params.values: Airspeed output type EAS (default) | CAS | TAS

params.name: Method
params.values: Method for computing conversion factor Table Lookup (default) | Equation

params.name: Subsonic airspeeds only
params.values: 用于亚声速空速 off (default) | on

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: 超出范围时的模块行为 None (default) | Warning | Error
